I've become aware from a few people that my join requests are not coming in, evaluating the logs it seems the notifications are being hidden  and deleted by the client automatically even without DND on. I will get more output logs from other users but in these logs I was in a private home world with Join Me on.

Steps used were simply to receive requests. I will post another output log when I get it from a friend of me sending a join request.
